title: Why "the Way"?
question: When Jesus says no one comes to the Father except through Him, what does He mean by being the only way, truth, and life?
blurb: Jesus calls Himself the road to the Father, and the rest of Scripture shows us where that road leads.

title: Why "the LORD is my shepherd"?
question: If the LORD is my shepherd, what does He actually do for me that means I shall not want?
blurb: David calls God his shepherd and lacks nothing. Trace what a shepherd does to see what that promise holds.

title: Made in God's Image?
question: What does Scripture show is true of people because they bear the image of God?
blurb: One verse says we bear God's image - trace what Scripture reveals that means for every human life.

title: What Rest Does Jesus Give?
question: What is the weariness Jesus invites us to bring Him, and what kind of rest does He promise in return?
blurb: Jesus calls the weary and burdened to come to Him - and what He offers in return is more than a pause from work.

title: By His Wounds, Healed?
question: How can the suffering and wounds of one person bring peace and healing to others?
blurb: A wounded Servant takes the punishment we earned, so that His hurt becomes our healing and peace.

title: Good in All Things?
question: For whom, and toward what end, does God work all things together for good?
blurb: A promise with an address: trace who it's for and the purpose it's aiming at.

title: Who Is the Word?
question: Who is "the Word" who was with God and was God in the beginning?
blurb: One verse hides a Person in plain sight, present at creation, with God and yet God. Follow the trail Scripture leaves.

title: Peace Over Anxiety
question: What does God give in place of our anxiety, and how do we receive it?
blurb: Instead of worry, Paul points us to prayer—and to a peace that guards the heart beyond all understanding.

title: Who Is "I AM"?
question: When God names Himself "I AM," what is He revealing about who He is?
blurb: At a burning bush, God answers Moses with a name unlike any other - and it still echoes across all of Scripture.

title: Whose Understanding?
question: What does it look like to trust the LORD with all my heart instead of leaning on my own understanding?
blurb: A daily look at what it means to hand God the whole heart and let Him straighten the road ahead.

title: Why Did Jesus Weep?
question: If Jesus knew He was about to raise Lazarus, what moved Him to weep at the tomb?
blurb: The shortest verse in the Bible holds the deepest comfort: God in the flesh, weeping with those who grieve.

title: Plans to Give a Hope
question: What does God say His plans for His people are, and on what does He base that promise?
blurb: A famous promise spoken to exiles: the LORD knows His plans, and they are toward a future and a hope.

title: What Is Love Really Like?
question: What is the love that "never fails" actually like, as Scripture describes it?
blurb: Paul paints love not as a feeling but as patient, humble action - trace what it does and where it comes from.

title: The First Promise
question: In the curse on the serpent, what does God promise about the woman's seed and the enemy's defeat?
blurb: Spoken in Eden's darkest hour, the first hint of a coming Rescuer who will crush the serpent.

title: Seek First His Kingdom
question: What does Jesus mean by seeking the kingdom of God first, and what does He promise will follow?
blurb: One command reorders everything we chase: put God's kingdom first, and watch what He promises to add.

title: Can a Heart Be Clean Again?
question: When sin has stained the heart, what is David asking God to do that only God can do?
blurb: David doesn't ask to fix himself; he asks God to create something new in him. What is that prayer really after?

title: What Faith Really Is
question: If faith is being sure of what we cannot see, what does the rest of Scripture show that confidence resting on?
blurb: Hebrews calls faith assurance and certainty - let's trace how the Bible itself fills out what that means.

title: What Does God Require?
question: If God has shown us what is good, what are the three things He asks of us in return?
blurb: God strips it all down to three simple, weighty words: do justice, love mercy, walk humbly with Him.

title: How Did God Love Us?
question: What does God's love look like in action, and what does He give to those who believe?
blurb: One verse holds the heart of the gospel - trace how God's love gives, saves, and lasts forever.

title: But If Not
question: What kind of faith trusts God even when He might not rescue?
blurb: Three men face the furnace with a faith that bows to no idol, whether God delivers them or not.

title: Why Be Still?
question: What truth about God lets us stop striving and rest, even when nations rage and the earth shakes?
blurb: A command to be still in the middle of chaos - and the reason it's possible: God Himself.

title: How Does God Prove His Love?
question: When did God show His love for us, and what did it cost Him?
blurb: God didn't wait for us to clean up first. See the timing and the cost that proved His love.

title: Who Will Go?
question: What makes Isaiah ready to answer "Here am I; send me"?
blurb: A holy God asks who will go, and one cleansed man dares to volunteer. What got him there?

title: No More Tears?
question: What does God promise to remove forever, and what makes that promise certain?
blurb: A glimpse of the end God is writing: every tear wiped, death undone, and all things made new.

title: Who Will See God?
question: What is a "pure" heart, and how does that purity lead to seeing God?
blurb: A clean heart is promised the greatest sight of all - God Himself. What does that purity look like, and how is it received?

title: Where Courage Comes From
question: What reason does God give Joshua to be strong and courageous instead of afraid?
blurb: A command to be brave that rests not on Joshua's strength, but on one promise: God goes with him wherever he goes.

title: Be Transformed, Not Conformed
question: How does renewing the mind change us, and what does it let us discern?
blurb: One verse, two paths: drift with the world, or be made new from the inside out.

title: Fearfully and Wonderfully Made?
question: What does it tell me about God that He made me so carefully, and how should I respond?
blurb: The same God who knit you together knows you completely - and that truth turns wonder into worship.

title: A Time for Everything?
question: If God sets a season for every purpose, how should we live within His timing rather than our own?
blurb: Every season under heaven has its hour. Trace how Scripture frames God's timing and how we are to meet it.

title: Sent to Make Disciples
question: What is the church actually sent to do, and on whose authority?
blurb: Before He ascended, Jesus gave one marching order. See what He sent His followers to do, and why.
